article.title: Meet the new ‘superstar’ of the Israeli left, who is so progressive she only supports apartheid
article.author: Jonathan Ofir
article.content: Naama Lazimi is being hailed as the Israeli left's rising star. But when she isn’t busy making excuses for the genocidal turn in Israeli society and politics, she’s advocating for a return to good old-fashioned apartheid.
